card.name: RESS in DRESS abbreviation
card.fires_on: Mainly the piece "RESS" completing the abbreviation DRESS (drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms) in lists of severe skin reactions. Also fires weakly on word endings such as "ULATION" in FORMULATION and "ings" in dressings.

modes.label: DRESS abbreviation
modes.description: The closing piece "RESS" of DRESS in parentheses after the full syndrome name.

modes.description: The end of a longer word that starts like "form" or "dress".
